s01472_0.summary: A four-person heist crew introduces itself in a salt mine elevator cage.
The cage stops, lamps go off, and Raff assigns roles toward the vault; Kite stays with the cage.

s01980.summary: A technician and a maintenance drone bicker as she fights a failing panel on a crippled ship.
Trading names, she calls the drone Winnow after her father's ship, and it names her Paloma.
Winnow offers to save the captain by sacrificing all cargo; Paloma tells it to do it.
Meltwater floods the walkway and Paloma runs after the drone to the airlock.

s01537.summary: Four thieves in black work on a jewelled watch case in a museum of ticking clocks.
Guard footsteps approach and the crew freezes behind the case until the beam passes.
Odette signals and the crew slips out into the night with the watch.

s02315.summary: Vivienne enters a nearly empty rooftop bar and sits beside a bloodstained stranger.
Quentin says he knows what her husband did Tuesday and that the barman is paid off.
He slides a photograph of her husband dead at a staircase's foot; she thanks him and tips.

s02269.summary: Weary soldiers rest in a ruined cathedral and Brandt decides to stay for the night.
Mikhail wakes and shares blankets; the radio is dead and they are on their own.
Brandt and Osei joke wryly about Christmas, cover the sleeping boy, and watch the first star.

s02430.summary: At the checkpoint, Vet Vance finds Nila's lead dog Biscuit favoring her wrist.
The marshal warns of closing weather and says Nila is in third, forty minutes behind.
Nila asks what Vance would do; she says scratch, as Biscuit wants only to please.
Nila picks Pepper as lead, confirms rolling, and heads out into the dark.
Vance kneels beside the old lead dog and promises Nila will be back.

s02211.summary: Plane-crash survivors ration water in the desert and Rigo refuses his share.
Rigo says to stay with the plane, but the woman calls him a liar.
Tess, then Gideon and Imani, give their names, and the strangers sit together.

s01848_1.summary: Sheriff Pike enters the saloon and finds Crane, a tied barkeep behind the bar.
Crane reveals her brother is in the back room; both draw guns.
Jonah calls from the stair, Pike lowers her gun, and her shackled brother descends.

s01275.summary: After the finals loss, Delphine and Ruben talk with Greta about her missed seven-ten.
Greta says she may quit after twelve years; Delphine and Ruben urge her to stay.
Delphine says the seven-ten feels like surviving, and Greta agrees to try again.
Ruben buys nachos and discovers his laces are knotted together, making them laugh.

s00220.summary: Foreman Odalys announces that inspection failed on weld seam forty-two.
Kirin owns up to the sign-off, and they discover no film was ordered, which was Odalys's job.
Branimir blames her; the ship cannot sail Friday because of a hairline crack.
Branimir proposes cutting the seam out tonight, and Odalys fetches mugs to make fresh tea.

s02370.summary: Sergeant Bello learns by radio that the push is called off and tells her squad.
They wade out slowly, disbelieving, as Captain Duarte radios he is coming down.
Li Wei laughs with relief; Bello and Wrona watch the silver terraces in quiet.

s00715.summary: Hazel, Ewan and the girl Mags wait in the farmhouse kitchen with a shotgun.
Deputy Cutter says the bridge is gone; Ewan asks over the radio about something in the corn.
A wet scraping comes from outside, which Mags recognizes from when they took her mother.
Hazel snuffs the lamp, something taps the glass, and they hide beneath the table.

s01498.summary: Wedding guests notice a drenched uninvited stranger at the conservatory door.
Dripping, he tells Gwenda he proposed to her daughter's mother here twenty-six years ago.
Gwenda whispers 'Daniel' as the music fades.

s00362.summary: A family fishes in a shack and takes in the shivering stranger Ruslan.
Margit mutters the ice is thinning and a deep groan rolls through the lake.
Halvard orders everyone out of the shack at once.

s00278.summary: Photographer Evelyn explores the abandoned planetarium and hears a creaking seat.
A smiling man in the third row says he did not come in; his shadow does not move.
The projector awakens, Ambrose reveals himself as a long-dead astronomer, and the stars move toward her.

s00349.summary: Restorer Noelle and apprentice Delphine work tensely on a piano while owner Leo watches.
Delphine tells Leo his late wife wanted middle C re-voiced and had hidden it from him.
Leo presses the flat key again, shoulders bending; Noelle and Delphine begin to tune it.

s01005.summary: At a seance, the skeptical Captain Lowry mocks Mrs. Crabtree as they join hands.
Taps sound, the table lifts, and a wheezing voice calls Hortensia.
The Captain is caught faking the voice with his boot; Mrs. Crabtree banishes him.

s02181.summary: Ilsa welds a coolant line in a submersible until the hatch wheel turns behind her.
The drifter Kestrel enters unlisted, and they size each other up warily.
Ilsa lunges for the radio, Kestrel grabs her and slams her against a pipe.
The weld fails and steams; he lets her go and holds the pipe while she fixes it.

s02093.summary: Teenage Leandra chats with night manager Dobrynin about his thirty-one years at the alley.
She recalls her absent father, and Dobrynin remembers him as generous and a man who left.
Dobrynin suggests bowling and Leandra gets him to agree to one frame.
He teases that her father bowled worse, she laughs tearfully, and they walk to Lane Twelve.

s01315.summary: Poet Giovanni and Contessa Isabella trade guarded words at a masquerade about an unfinished story.
Her husband Alvise returns early in a raven mask, bows, and drinks her wine.
Alvise raises a toast to fidelity, and Isabella answers under her breath with 'To the masks'.

s02491.summary: Darius visits his mother Eunice at her tackle shop, trading mild banter.
He says he knows she is closing the shop and has hidden a folder in the register.
Dr. Anand has also called him; Eunice admits she meant to tell him at Easter.
Darius invites her to live with him and she agrees if the cat and rods come.

s00020.summary: Ignatius pours tea for relief keeper Tamsin in the lighthouse fog-signal room.
He sees water pooling uphill beneath her boots and asks if she came up alone.
Wet footsteps climb the stairs, the horn blares, and they slam the hatch shut.

s00906.summary: Lucy meets Tariq at the abandoned drive-in and they sit on a dead truck in silence.
Lucy recalls her father bringing her here and leaving the next fall.
Tariq shares his earbuds and jokes about seeing the horse until she cries and laughs.
They thank each other as a firefly crosses the empty screen.

s02087.summary: Piano tuner Marguerite plays an answering machine message containing nine seconds of silent breath.
She replays the message repeatedly while tuning a flat note, growing agitated.
She snaps the lever, unplugs the machine, and plays a perfectly tuned chord.

s02172.summary: Heist boss Renata says the haul is two bags short and the crew turns on each other.
Calloway lunges at Junior until Wren warns of headlights, which pass.
A bag splashes at Tomasz's feet, the crew stares at him, then scatters.
